about: The Mean Well IRM-60-5ST the ADLSC README names feeds J1; WLED's current limit of 5 A (README) shared by the two LED outputs, and the 3 A of the two fuses; the ESP32 at its TX peak. Values with 'note' are assumptions.

J1.note: Mean Well IRM-60-5: 5 V, 10 A rated, voltage tolerance ±2.5 % including line and load regulation (IRM-60 specification, LCSC copy of C6969430, read 2026-11-03); r_ohm: two 0.5 m wires of AWG 18, the README's least gauge – the length is an assumption

standby.about: WLED runs, the LED power off (POWER_ON low), the data lines low

wled_5a.about: the LED power on, WLED's current limit of 5 A (README: 'Current limit to 5A') shared by the two outputs, the data lines high
wled_5a.note: an even split between the two sections is an assumption; the 80 × 8 matrix the README configures draws 35 A at full white – WLED's limit keeps it at 5 A

fuses_3a.about: each LED output at its fuse's rating, 3 A – the README sizes the fuses as (10 A − 1 A) / 3 for the 10 A supply

A1.note: WLED drives the LED data on GPIO25 (and GPIO26) and the LED power on GPIO4 (README, Firmware and ESP32 pins)
